title: Optimization Utility Functions
summary: This module provides helper functions for monitoring and evaluating program optimization trials. It includes utilities for inspecting model execution history, logging token usage, and calculating the quality of proposed programs over time.

nodes.label: Monitor Program Execution
nodes.title: Get Task Model History
nodes.description: Retrieves the full execution trace and history of a task model for a given candidate program and example, aiding in debugging and analysis.

nodes.label: Log Model Token Usage
nodes.title: Log Token Usage
nodes.description: Extracts and records the total input and output token counts for each language model used in a specific optimization trial, storing this data in trial logs.

nodes.label: Calculate Program Quality
nodes.title: Calculate Proposed Program Quality
nodes.description: Determines the average and best quality scores (on both training and development sets) for the most recently proposed programs based on historical trial logs.

nodes.label: Evaluate Program Performance
nodes.title: Evaluation Function
nodes.description: An external function or metric used to assess the performance of a given program against a dataset, returning a score.

nodes.label: Task Model Instance
nodes.title: DSPy Task Model
nodes.description: The DSPy program or module whose internal execution history is being inspected or traced during an optimization run.

nodes.label: Optimization Trial Logs
nodes.title: Trial Logs
nodes.description: A structured record (e.g., dictionary) storing detailed metadata, program paths, and scores for each optimization trial.

nodes.label: Language Model Configurations
nodes.title: Model Dictionary
nodes.description: A collection of language model instances, typically used to query their token usage statistics.

nodes.label: Development Dataset
nodes.title: Dev Set
nodes.description: A dataset used for evaluating the performance of programs during development and for calculating development scores.

nodes.label: Training Dataset
nodes.title: Train Set
nodes.description: A dataset used for training or for calculating training scores of programs during optimization.

nodes.label: Program Artifact Paths
nodes.title: Program Paths
nodes.description: References to saved program states or artifacts, which are loaded to re-evaluate past proposed programs.

groups.label: Program Analysis
groups.title: Program Analysis & Evaluation
groups.description: Functions dedicated to analyzing the behavior and evaluating the performance of optimized programs.

groups.label: Data & Logs
groups.title: Data Sources and Logs
groups.description: External data structures and logs that serve as inputs or outputs for the utility functions.

groups.label: External Components
groups.title: External Dependencies
groups.description: Components or functions that are external to this module but are utilized by its utilities.

groups.label: Monitoring Utility
groups.title: Monitoring Utility
groups.description: A utility function focused on monitoring and logging specific metrics during optimization trials.
